translations.web: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.
translations.bsb: You are the most handsome of men; grace has anointed your lips; therefore God has blessed you forever.
translations.kjv: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
translations.asv: Thou art fairer than the children of men; Grace is poured into thy lips: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
